name: Aleutian Current
scope: OSW regional eastward Subarctic/Aleutian reference reach, 175 E to 140 W, following the circulation convention in Favorite (1967) Figure 27. Gates truncate the schematic and are selected by OSW; they are not current origin or termination. Westward Alaskan Stream, West Wind Drift/North Pacific Current, Bering branches and downstream Alaska/California branches are excluded.
layer: Upper-ocean schematic geography; source Figure 27 is a circulation schematic with transports referred to 1000 m, not a fixed-depth velocity axis. No depth-specific geometry extracted.
time_convention: Undated OSW reference sketch of the author circulation schematic. Paper observations May-August 1959 provide context; this line is neither simultaneous observed geometry nor a 1959 seasonal frame.
source_locator: Printed p. 2 Background (Aleutian/Subarctic naming); pp. 11-12 Relative Currents (eastward Subarctic versus westward Alaskan Stream); p. 19 Figure 27 schematic. Cited text pages read; Figure 27 visually inspected.
source_citation: Favorite, F. (1967), The Alaskan Stream, Bulletin 21, International North Pacific Fisheries Commission, pp. 1-20. Manuscript dated June 1965; publication 1967.
source_license: US government author, NOAA-hosted publication. Only paraphrased facts and independently selected OSW geometry packaged; original figure/PDF not redistributed.
coordinate_selection: OSW rounded waypoints follow the eastward Subarctic branch in Figure 27. Coordinates are editorial approximations, not calibrated digitization or measured cores. The 175 E gate omits western formation/return-flow confluence; 140 W is a regional truncation before coastal branching. Alternative end at 145 W tests gate convention. Latitude shifts test drawing convention, not current width.

scenario_rule: Four declared schematic/gate choices crossed with three uniform longitude shifts and independent endpoint latitude shifts (-0.5/0/+0.5 degrees): 108 editorial cases. Envelope is not uncertainty, physical width, seasonal extrema or a confidence interval.
remaining_gates: Review schematic identity against modern layer-compatible velocity fields and North Pacific Current naming.
Replace editorial waypoints with connected, sourced velocity-core geometry; diagnose upstream and downstream gates.
Resolve Bering and Alaska/California branches without adding overlapping components.
Acquire month/depth-resolved axes and paired boundaries before annual length or width ranges; no seasonal playback from this schematic.
method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed. Explicit date-line policy: longitude-normalized scenario vertices, continuously unwrapped geodesic display, and periodic land/state/crop joins.
map_land_check: All 108 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
